description: Firestore Collection Ownership Registry - Each collection MUST be owned by exactly ONE service

_migrations.description: Database migration tracking - managed by scripts/migrate.mjs

notion_connections.description: Notion OAuth connection tokens and state

research_export_settings.description: Notion research export page ID configuration per user

whatsapp_messages.description: WhatsApp messages with transcription and link preview metadata

whatsapp_user_mappings.description: Phone number to user ID mappings for WhatsApp integration. Shape: { userId, phoneNumbers, connected, createdAt, updatedAt }. Notification preferences are stored separately in whatsapp_notification_preferences (INT-1542).

whatsapp_notification_preferences.description: Per-user WhatsApp notification preferences (notificationLevel: 'all' | 'important'). Structurally isolated from user mappings so notificationLevel can never leak into the public WhatsAppUserMappingPublic projection (INT-1542).

whatsapp_webhook_events.description: Raw WhatsApp webhook events for audit and debugging

whatsapp_outbound_messages.description: Tracking of outbound WhatsApp messages with wamid and correlationId for reply matching

whatsapp_phone_verifications.description: Phone number verification codes with TTL-based expiry for WhatsApp connection

whatsapp_private_accounts.description: Per-user private WhatsApp mirror accounts mapping external Matrix source account IDs to canonical IntexuraOS users.

whatsapp_private_chats.description: Private WhatsApp chat metadata synchronized from Matrix/mautrix bridge events. Separate from WhatsApp Business API collections.

whatsapp_private_messages.description: Read-only private WhatsApp messages synchronized from Matrix/mautrix bridge events. Separate from WhatsApp Business API messages and mobile notifications.

whatsapp_private_senders.description: Per-private-WhatsApp-sender profile aggregate keyed by source account and sender identity.

whatsapp_private_sender_days.description: Per-private-WhatsApp-sender daily aggregates for time-range reads and future daily summaries.

whatsapp_conversation_assistant_sessions.description: Private WhatsApp Conversation Assistant sessions with frozen transcript snapshots and public metadata.

whatsapp_conversation_assistant_turns.description: Autosaved user and assistant turns for private WhatsApp Conversation Assistant sessions.

mobile_notifications.description: Mobile push notifications received from user devices

mobile_notification_signatures.description: Device signature to user ID bindings for notification delivery

mobile_notifications_filters.description: User filter options and saved filters for notifications

user_settings.description: User preferences and LLM API keys (encrypted)

oauth_connections.description: Third-party OAuth tokens (Google, Microsoft) - AES-256-GCM encrypted

researches.description: LLM research queries, responses, and synthesized results

intex_agent_sessions.description: Product-visible WhatsApp Assistant sessions owned by intex-agent, including lifecycle status and summary fields.

intex_agent_session_events.description: Chronological timeline events for intex-agent WhatsApp Assistant sessions, including user messages, assistant replies, clarifications, tool calls, and close events.

intex_agent_user_preferences.description: Legacy INTEX Agent per-user configuration used for External Save settings. Prompt instructions are stored in dedicated prompt-preference collections. Document id == userId.

intex_agent_prompt_preferences.description: Current itemized INTEX Agent prompt preferences per user with rendered prompt block and current version. Document id == userId.

intex_agent_prompt_preference_versions.description: Immutable INTEX Agent prompt preference version snapshots. Document id format: {userId}_{version}.

generated_images.description: Generated thumbnail images and their metadata

notes.description: User-scoped notes with tags and source tracking

bookmarks.description: User-scoped bookmarks with OG metadata, AI summaries, and tags

calendar_failed_events.description: Failed calendar event extractions for manual review

calendar_processed_actions.description: Successfully processed calendar actions for idempotency

calendar_previews.description: Calendar event previews generated async before user approval

linear_connections.description: Linear API key connections and team configuration

linear_failed_issues.description: Failed Linear issue creations for manual review

linear_issues.description: Locally synced Linear issues with webhook and full-sync support

linear_issue_comments.description: Synced Linear issue comments from webhook events

linear_prune_candidates.description: Prune candidates classified by Gemini for user review before deletion

user_spend.description: User cost tracking for rate limiting

code_worker_settings.description: Per-user worker configuration with encrypted credentials (CF Access, dispatch signing) for Mac and VM workers

github-pr-events.description: GitHub pull request webhook events for PR timeline and context in Code Agent UI

github-webhook-audit-events.description: Auth-passed GitHub webhook deliveries persisted before normalization so every saved delivery can be linked to a decision

sentry-issue-events.description: Sentry issue webhook reservations and audit records used to create exactly one code task per actionable Sentry issue

github-event-log-entries.description: Lightweight live projection for the GitHub event decision log UI, used as the Firestore change feed for row hydration

github-pr-summaries.description: PR summaries for 30-day list view. One doc per unique PR, upserted on every webhook.

pr_task_locks.description: PR task locks ensuring only one Claude task runs per PR at a time (INT-465)

event_decisions.description: Audit trail of webhook event evaluation decisions (hard rules or LLM triage)

dispatch_retries.description: Failed webhook dispatch retry queue with TTL and max-attempts bounds

code_task_system_statuses.description: Durable user-visible system statuses for code-task dispatch blockers

code_task_dispatch_notifications.description: Durable dispatch-failure notification ledger keyed by task, channel, reason, and phase

pr_automation_comments.description: PR automation comment tracking for unified PR log (one doc per PR, keyed by repository:prNumber)

merge_queue_watches.description: Merge queue watch state for automated PR merging

execution_memories.description: Execution memory lessons distilled from completed code tasks with vector embeddings for similarity retrieval

execution_memory_applications.description: Tracks how execution memories were applied to tasks and their post-run evaluation results

task_group_summaries.description: Precomputed group-level aggregates for code task issue groups (one doc per userId+linearIssueId)

user_group_counts.description: Per-user group status counts for code task filter badges (active, needs-action, done, failed)

hellscript_buffers.description: Hellscript thought buffers with materialized state

hellscript_writing_config.description: User-level writing configuration with style instructions per category

llm_usage_events.description: Raw LLM usage events with per-call token, cost, and correlation data

llm_usage_daily_aggregates.description: Daily aggregated LLM usage metrics by owner, service, provider, model, and operation

llm_pricing.description: LLM pricing per provider (one doc per provider, keyed by provider ID)

notification_daily_digests.description: Daily WhatsApp digest summaries per user and group. Doc ID format: {userId}_{groupKey}_{YYYY-MM-DD}. Immutable after write.

notification_group_states.description: Per-date snapshots of WhatsApp group state. Doc ID format: {userId}_{groupKey}_{YYYY-MM-DD}. Each daily run writes its own snapshot; 'current latest' = orderBy(date desc) limit 1.

notification_digest_locks.description: Advisory locks serializing concurrent digest runs per (userId, groupKey). 5-minute TTL. Doc ID format: {userId}_{groupKey}.

notification_digest_backfill_runs.description: Progress tracking for digest backfill runs. One doc per run; mutated as the HTTP-chain processes each day.

fishing_knowledge_folders.description: Per-user Fishing Assistant knowledge folders used to group manually pasted source pages.

fishing_knowledge_pages.description: Per-user Fishing Assistant raw and normalized knowledge pages used as RAG sources.

fishing_knowledge_chunks.description: Per-user Fishing Assistant searchable page chunks with vector embeddings for RAG retrieval.

fishing_chats.description: Per-user Fishing Assistant chat sessions with derived titles and latest-message summary fields.

fishing_chat_messages.description: Per-user Fishing Assistant user/assistant messages with citations and confidence metadata.
